resolved_findings.finding: Abort on the exact edge accepting a held successful Dense terminal passes response_ready unchanged. DenseOwnerModel captures the old success tuple before local_reset sets owner.error, then accepts that stale tuple. Both adapters interpret it as success and publish the intermediate D even though abort was issued and the owner/backend become poisoned. Full-block roots remain protected by coordinator.aborted; the adapter terminal/publication contract is nevertheless violated.
resolved_findings.minimal_fix: Suppress response_ready on the first abort/numeric-fault edge, allowing the next owner terminal to carry the actual fault; apply to both adapters or correct the shared owner without changing unrelated protocols.
resolved_findings.mechanical_acceptance: For each adapter, reach a held successful terminal with complete final ACK and no pending transport, then tick(abort=True,response_ready=True). Assert no successful terminal and no D publication; then drain one failed response, one Matrix release, poisoned resources, and reset-required admission blocking. Add equivalent coordinator coverage for a Dense stage.
resolved_findings.waiver: None for the advertised abort/no-publication transport contract.
resolved_findings.resolution: Both adapters now gate response_ready with not reset_edge, preserving the held pre-edge response until the real owner exposes its faulted terminal. Four lifecycle regressions are shared by both adapter suites.

resolved_findings.finding: Vector policy and fatal mask are sealed, but RMS reduction policy self.policy is omitted from the sealed identity and reread for post_norm. A caller can switch reduction policy during one invocation or between cold/carried windows without rejection.
resolved_findings.minimal_fix: Include the normalized RMS reduction policy in the immutable configuration/resource seal and test a policy mutation between owner commands.
resolved_findings.mechanical_acceptance: After cold start, assign the other valid RMS ReductionPolicy and confirm the next tick/start rejects before further arithmetic or publication.
resolved_findings.waiver: May be waived only if mutable per-stage RMS policy is explicitly intended and reported; current single rms_policy API/report implies one selection.
resolved_findings.resolution: Normalized RMS ReductionPolicy is included in the resource seal. A new test changes it after attention_residual and verifies rejection before post_norm launch or joint commit.

checks.prelaunch_inputs: Only raw BF16 inputs and original checkpoint parameters are preloaded; weight transpose preserves BF16 bits. All intermediate/history/state/prefix/scratch destinations are fresh guarded allocations.
checks.chain_dependencies: All sixteen owners consume exact physical spans. Typed drivers require prior ACKed/published producers. Chunk core is explicitly published only after its staging terminal, while its state stays private.
checks.dual_state_fence: Final residual success is held for checks of exact Conv/chunk receipts, full history/state/output ACK coverage, drained resources, immutable raw/producer hashes, unchanged preceding roots and generation. The synchronous software commit then publishes both new roots and advances once.
checks.cold_carried: Cold owners internally initialize zero history/state rather than consuming sentinels. Carried jobs take the last committed history/state addresses and generation; failed carried work preserves the previous pair.
checks.shared_identity: One retained Dense owner/A-B banks/MatrixService, one PrepScalar, and one Vector16 are reused. Vector policy/mask and RMS reduction policy are sealed. Reset is admitted only after draining and keeps physical resources in place.
checks.seeded_down: Exactly two ascending-K chunks with K3584 split2560. Full FP32 context bytes are written, ACKed, privately reread in the original permutation, hashed/versioned, and fed to real seed begin/beat/commit/ACK on the same five contexts. No prefix BF16 rounding or oracle-produced seed.
checks.scope: Reports explicitly deny public Command128 execution, RTL execution, hardware cycle/utilization claims and native acceptance. IEEE vector mode keeps the legacy default and explicit current Chisel integration gap.
